pattern: SELECT [A-ZA-Z_]+ FROM ([A-ZA-Z]+) JOIN ([A-ZA-Z]+) AS [A-ZA-Z] + ON ([A-ZA-Z_]+).id = [A-ZA-Z]_.Channel WHERE ([A-ZA-Z_]+).Directed\_by != 'Ben Jones' GROUP BY [A-ZA-Z_]+ HAVING COUNT\((\[A-ZA-Z_]+\.id\) = 0)
correction: SELECT package_option FROM TV_Channel WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT channel FROM cartoon WHERE directed_by = 'Ben Jones')

metadata.description: This rule identifies and corrects queries that unnecessarily join tables, which can lead to incorrect results. It also addresses the issue of filtering out rows based on a column from a joined table instead of directly filtering the main table.
